name: DiscordSC
author: oparada1988
short_description: Full Discord voice, soundboard, channel, call mixer & notification control over local IPC.
description:
Communicates directly with your local Discord desktop client over Discord IPC for real-time, bi-directional state synchronization — no StreamController installation required.

Toggle microphone mute, deafen, push-to-talk, and input modes with live connection-aware icons, jump into voice or text channels, trigger soundboard clips, monitor unread DM notifications, and mix per-user call volumes right from Stream Deck + dials.

actions.name: Mute Toggle
actions.description: Toggle Discord microphone mute with live visual state

actions.name: Deafen Toggle
actions.description: Instantly deafen and mute active Discord voice

actions.name: Call Mixer
actions.description: Adjust per-participant voice volume & mute on dials and LCD

actions.name: Soundboard
actions.description: Play any server soundboard clip in your active voice channel

actions.name: Voice Channel
actions.description: Join or leave a pinned Discord voice channel with live indicator

actions.name: Text Channel
actions.description: Jump straight to a pinned Discord text channel

actions.name: Push to Talk
actions.description: Hold key to transmit microphone audio with active indicator

actions.name: Input Mode
actions.description: Switch between Voice Activity and Push-to-Talk mode

actions.name: Server Status
actions.description: Live server icon and online member count badge

actions.name: Notification Hub
actions.description: Cycle unread DMs & mentions with avatar and count badge
